1. Summary of the primary business
a. Business Overview – Products and Services
We are a customer experience (“CX”) service provider delivering services across multiple channels, 
including voice, email, chat, social media and message, in a cost-effective manner with technology playing 
a central role in our service delivery model. Our services include customer acquisition services, customer 
service, order fulfillment support, payment and collections services, customer retention services, technical 
support, digital solutions and AI data infrastructure services such as data collection, data annotation and 
labelling, and teleoperations services. Our in-house developed AI solutions include MindVoice, Mind 
WorkPlace and Arya.
b. Industries Served and Typical Customers
Our business process solutions and services company maintains focus on customers in the following key 
verticals: (i) telecom and other utilities; (ii) hi-tech growth and travel; (iii) banking, financial services and 
insurance; (iv) retail; and (v) healthcare.
c. Segment Reporting and Revenue Contribution
We operate in a single reportable segment i.e., business process management services,
d. Key Geographies
As of June 30, 2026, we have divided our global operations into four main regions: (i) Latin America; (ii) 
North America; (iii) Europe and Africa; and (iv) Southeast Asia:
We operate 40 delivery centres and two sales offices across 13 countries.
Our customers are primarily located in United States, Canada, El Salvador and Morocco.

2. Summary of the Industry (Source: Everest Report)
The global Customer Experience (CX) market is undergoing significant transformation, fueled by rising 
customer expectations, accelerated digital adoption, and the integration of AI and automation technologies. 
According to Everest Group, the CX industry was valued at approximately INR34.54 trillion (US$360 
billion) in 2025 and is expected to grow to INR35.03 trillion (US$365.2 billion) by 2027, driven by 
enterprises’ increasing emphasis on delivering seamless, omnichannel, and personalized customer 
experiences. Outsourced CX, which accounted for approximately 33% of the market in 2025, continues to 
grow faster than in-house CX. Its share is expected to rise to approximately 34.5% by 2027, driven by cost 
efficiencies, faster deployment, and access to next-generation capabilities such as gen AI, language 
translation, and multilingual omnichannel support.
For further and complete information, see “Industry Overview” on page 145 of the Red Herring Prospectus.
